annotations.title: Tokenized treasury funds onchain: BUIDL, USDY, OUSG, USTB, USYC, BENJI supply, NAV, AUM, 24 h / 7 d flows

description: Use when an agent tracks tokenized US Treasury / money market funds. Input: optional token (BUIDL, USDY, OUSG, USTB, USYC, BENJI), chain (all, ethereum, base). Output: JSON per token totalSupply, NAV per share from Chainlink or the issuer's onchain oracle ($1 for constant-NAV funds, null if none), AUM, mint/burn flows 24 h / 7 d in units and USD, totals. Ethereum + Base issuance only. Cached 10 min. Use instead: proof_of_reserve for reserve coverage of wrapped/backed tokens. Example: ?token=BUIDL Price: $0.005 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.
